description: The New York string quartet, for fifty years one of the most influential ensembles in contemporary music, plays the renovated Gazarte Main Stage on a single Athens night. Priced by zone.

# title: Jazz at the Museum: Yiotis Samaras – "2 to 3: Acoustic Duo to Electric Trio"
description: Guitarist Yiotis Samaras, a founding member of Page One, with Kostas Konstantinou on double bass in the acoustic programme Lunar Breeze, then Haris Charalabous (electric bass) and Dimitris Klonis (drums) for Coltrane, Henderson and the Beatles. Part of the museum's Jazz at the Museum series, this year titled "Numbers"; 16€ for B&E members.

The Berlin trio of Moses Yoofee (piano, keyboards), Roman Klobe (bass) and Noah Fürbringer (drums), twice awarded at the German Jazz Prize — Best Live Act 2024 and Best Debut Album 2026 — plays its genre-blending instrumental music between jazz, hip-hop, Afrobeat and electronics. Tickets via more.com.

Pianist Andronikos Sotiriou, based in Barcelona, presents his first personal album Short Stories with Alkis Ntiled (guitar), Giorgos Pantazopoulos (double bass) and Dimitris Klonis (drums): short musical stories linking contemporary jazz with blues, rock and classical music. Tickets via more.com.

# title: Mirela Pachou & Adam Tsarouchis: And These Christmas Nights With You
description: The two singers return to the Half Note for two Wednesdays, 9 and 16 December, with a Christmas programme of swing, pop, Latin and disco, with Dimitris Moutafis (bass), Thanassis Terpsopoulos (piano) and Dimitris Christodoulakis (drums). Tickets via more.com.

Singer Eleni Arapoglou, born in London and raised in Athens, reworks Beatles songs with Yannis Papadopoulos (piano), George Constantinou (electric bass) and Panagiotis Kostopoulos (drums); her collaborations with Leonel Garcia and Thana Alexa have been Grammy and Latin Grammy nominated. Tickets via more.com.
The Northern Irish blues and soul singer brings her six-piece Hope Experiment — piano, guitars, bouzouki, cello, drums — for a four-night run, Friday and Saturday at 22:00. Tickets via more.com.

# title: Jazz at the Museum: Dimitris Tsakas, Alexandros Drakos Ktistakis, Mariza Kapsabeli – "Three"
description: Saxophonist Dimitris Tsakas, curator of the series, and drummer and keyboardist Alexandros Drakos Ktistakis improvise with electronics against the photography and video of Mariza Kapsabeli: ambient textures, winds, percussion and guitar in a music-and-image dialogue. 16€ for B&E members.

The Athenian swing band, first prize winners at Swinging Europe 2021, play originals and their own arrangements from the 1930s and 1940s and the Christmas songbook, with Stergios Polyzos (tenor saxophone), Alexis Stenakis (clarinet, piano), Elisavet Mitsou (guitar, voice), Haris Pantazis (double bass) and Alexandros Karalias (drums). Tickets via more.com.

# title: Jazz at the Museum: Markos Chaidemenos – "Light Beam"
description: Pianist and composer Markos Chaidemenos presents his fifth solo album Light Beam, bridging jazz and contemporary classical writing, with Irini Arabatzi (voice, lyrics), Babis Karasavvidis (violin) and Yorgos Tamiolakis (cello). 16€ for B&E members.

# title: Horacio "El Negro" Hernandez: Taste of Latin
description: Bassist Yiorgos Fakanas and his group meet the great Cuban drummer Horacio "El Negro" Hernandez, of Irakere and the Tony Martinez bands and drummer on Pat Metheny and Michel Camilo records, for two nights of Afro-Cuban rhythms inside Fakanas's jazz-fusion compositions. Tickets via more.com.
